definitions.explanation: An area of Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, famous for its secondhand bookshops and publishers. The name stands for book lovers' Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {神保町|じんぼうちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古本|ふるほん}→古本：14745_furuhon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I hunted for secondhand books in Jinbōchō.

examples.japanese: {神保町|じんぼうちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名店|めいてん}→名店：21511_meiten⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Jinbōchō also has many famous curry restaurants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神保町|じんぼうちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古書店|こしょてん}→古書店：22184_koshoten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧{本好|ほんず}きでにぎわう。
examples.english: On weekends, Jinbōchō is busy with book lovers making the rounds of the secondhand bookshops.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Well over a hundred secondhand bookshops line its streets, one of the largest such districts in the world. Every autumn it holds the {神田古本|かんだふるほん}まつり (Kanda Secondhand Book Festival).
- It is also known for curry restaurants.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {神田神保町|かんだじんぼうちょう}: the full address name
- {神保町|じんぼうちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{古書店街|こしょてんがい}: the Jinbōchō bookshop district
